<timestamp>Wednesday, Sep 9, 2026, 4:08 PM (UTC+8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
这台mac上的bus消息 不会通过tg私聊发给我 对吗？
</user_query>
先核对这台 Mac 上 agent-bus 与 TG 私聊镜像的配置，再直接回答你。
继续查这台机的 TG mirror 开关与「仅 old-mac」相关配置。

input.command: hostname; ls -la "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/" 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/agent-bus/ 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/config/agent-bus.env 2>/dev/null; rg -n "TG_|TELEGRAM|MIRROR|status_mirror|incoming|OLD_MAC|HOST" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/" /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/agent-bus/ /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/config/ 2>/dev/null | head -80
input.description: Check hostname and TG mirror config

input.command: ls -la "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/config/"; cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/config/agent-bus.env" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; echo "WORKLOG_HOST_ID=${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-}"; cat ~/.dc-platform/host_id 2>/dev/null; cat ~/.dc-platform/config/host* 2>/dev/null; rg -n "WORKLOG_HOST|HOST_ID|new-mac|old-mac|TG_MIRROR|status_mirror|AGENT_BUS_TG" ~/.dc-platform/ /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/scripts/ 2>/dev/null | head -60
input.description: Read agent-bus env and host id

input.command: cat ~/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; launchctl list 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'youchu|agent-bus|tgbot|mirror' || true; ls "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/" 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'youchu|agent|tg|bus' || true; ls "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac/" 2>/dev/null | head -40; pgrep -lf 'agent_bus|tgbot|mirror' 2>/dev/null | head -20; tail -5 "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_tg_status.jsonl" 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot 2>/dev/null | head -5; test -f /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/.env && rg -n 'STATUS_MIRROR|MIRROR|HOST|DISABLE' /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/.env 2>/dev/null | head -30
input.description: Check host role and running TG/bus

content.text:
对，**按分工就是这样**。

这台是 **new-mac（编码机）**：`WORKLOG_HOST_ID=new-mac`，bot / poller / `status_mirror` 故意不跑（`disable-local-automation-new-mac.sh`）。

| 机 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| **old-mac** | TG bot + agent-bus poller + 私聊镜像（权威） |
| **new-mac（本机）** | 写代码；本地 `tg_status` 旧机 bot 读不到 → **不会进你 TG 私聊** |

所以：在这台机上回 bus，私聊里通常看不到结案；派单接单、ACK/结案镜像应在 **旧机 Cursor** 做。日报自动推私聊也只在 old-mac。

不要为了「私聊能看见」在本机再启 bot/poller 或加直推（会双开抢活）。
